datasets.caveat: Prospective controlled adaptation. Same-host warmed decoder mean time versus undamped canonical BP+OSD0, not campaign elapsed time. Joint damping/constant-or-paper scaling/offset search; alpha*max(0,min_abs-beta), old-V2C damping. Every tested control/cap retained. Training never pooled with fresh confirmation. Preserve full cap progression for previous damping and selected joint settings. Runtime tolerance10%, explicit saturation/search ceilings and over-budget starting points. Binary BP X-only; Q-BP joint depolarizing at1.5p_X, distinct channels. Timings are host/cohort dependent; report actual ratios, not assumed equality. No source-reproduction or global-optimality claim.

datasets.caveat: Controlled CSS X-only adaptations of BeamSearch and RelayBP on all original Roffe rates; unchanged canonical float64 min-sum sweeps, original-syndrome stopping and independent logical evaluation. No circuit-paper reproduction, Pauli Q-BP result or global-optimum claim. LER-first finite numerical/topology/memory tuning, separate coarse/finalist/fresh cohorts. Mean latency targets0.5/1/2/4 times same-CPU undamped BP+OSD0; actual timing and approximate1%-bin tail quantiles are explicit. All branches, discarded work, masking, random draws and selection included. Different selected controls are never silently pooled.

assessment.contrasts: each selected family versus the fixed reference at each rate
assessment.decision_rule: Report a directional difference only when adjusted p <= 0.05 and the observed difference has that direction; otherwise inconclusive. No decoder ranking follows from a single code or noise model.
assessment.multiplicity: Holm familywise adjustment over all non-reference family-by-rate contrasts
assessment.paired_effect_power_status: No minimum detectable paired effect is guaranteed by 512 shots; nonsignificant contrasts remain inconclusive.
assessment.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar via binomial test on discordant matched samples
assessment.primary_endpoint: unconditional_failure = any terminal outcome other than exact or stabilizer_equivalent
assessment.rate_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval on all terminal samples

configuration.claim_scope: Controlled CSS adaptation on BB72; no Bravyi circuit-level, BPGD source-curve, or BP-SF source-curve reproduction claim.
configuration.question: On the source-pinned [[72,12,6]] BB code under independent X-only code-capacity noise, how do compatible BP updates and two BP-internal interventions change unconditional valid-recovery probability and measured work under a shared edge-message cap?

selection_rule.selected_for_evaluation: one configuration per family plus fixed SPA gamma=1 reference
selection_rule.unit: one decoder family across all three selection rates

shared_work.other_work: Retain and report all typed non-message work, BP calls, wall time, and resource context separately; the edge cap is not equal total CPU cost.

source_settings_view.reason: The pinned source uses circuit-level BP-OSD; this study has perfect-syndrome X-only CSS noise and BP-only arms.
source_settings_view.source: Bravyi et al., arXiv:2308.07915 and sbravyi/BivariateBicycleCodes@fa77e333

source_settings_view.reason: The controlled BB72 arm uses T=5 and R=8 under the common cap; the B1 source reports T=10 or 100 and a larger decimation envelope.
source_settings_view.source: Yao et al., arXiv:2312.10950v2, Algorithm 1 and B1 simulations

source_settings_view.reason: The same V2C recurrence is used on an X-bit-flip channel with project-selected gamma values; published erasure-channel optimized gamma values are not imported.
source_settings_view.source: Gokduman, Yao and Pfister, arXiv:2411.08177v2, Eq. 17

source_settings_view.reason: Seeded stable test order and first-valid original-problem selection replace source unseeded parallel arrival semantics.

assessment.decision_rule: A primary contrast is directional only with Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 and matching observed sign. Otherwise inconclusive; no general decoder ranking follows from BB72 alone.
assessment.multiplicity: Holm familywise correction across the two p080 primary contrasts at alpha=0.05
assessment.primary_endpoint: unconditional_failure; only exact or stabilizer-equivalent recovery is valid
assessment.rate_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson on every all-terminal denominator
assessment.secondary: All p050 contrasts, gamma=0.5 arms, BP20 controls, outcome transitions, typed work and runtime are descriptive with exact binomial intervals; no unadjusted directional claims.
assessment.test: two-sided exact paired McNemar on discordant matched shots

configuration.claim_scope: Independent controlled X-only BB72 CSS adaptation. The min-sum BP-SF arm remains different from the source's unseeded parallel first-arrival execution; no author-code reproduction or parallel-latency claim.

cohort.v1_overlap_rule: new physical sample namespace and seed; no v1 shot is reused or pooled

configuration.question: Does the BB72 v1 BP-SF gain at p=0.08 replicate, and how does it depend on canonical SPA versus min-sum updates, V2C damping, and BP-only sweep allowance?

sample_size_basis.method: exact binomial rejection region, binomial mixture over discordant count, conservative two-sided alpha=0.025 per primary contrast
sample_size_basis.qualification: Sensitivity calculation, not a guaranteed effect or power for the unknown min-sum contrast. The v1 effect is not pooled with v2 inference.

shared_work.cost_reporting: Report BP messages and calls, all additional typed intervention work, and measured controller runtime separately. A common message cap is not equal total work or parallel latency.
shared_work.runtime_comparison_status: same-node descriptive serial execution only; different measurement scopes and control overhead are disclosed
shared_work.runtime_method: time.perf_counter_ns:phase5-controller:v1 for intervention arms; ordinary canonical decode runtime for BP-only arms

Min-sum update is source-informed, but seeded serial first-valid selection and fixed BB72 CSS conditions remain different from the paper.
The source BB72 experiment used circuit-level BP-OSD, not perfect-syndrome X-only CSS BP.

studies.label: Does the BB72 v1 BP-SF gain at p=0.08 replicate, and how does it depend on canonical SPA versus min-sum updates, V2C damping, and BP-only sweep allowance?
studies.source_status: Independent controlled X-only BB72 CSS adaptation. The min-sum BP-SF arm remains different from the source's unseeded parallel first-arrival execution; no author-code reproduction or parallel-latency claim.

configuration.evaluation_rule: All evaluation profiles run on matched, independent physical samples. Four selected Beam-versus-Relay rate/damping contrasts use two-sided exact paired McNemar tests and Holm familywise correction at alpha=0.05; all other contrasts are descriptive. Every terminal shot counts; exact and stabilizer-equivalent outcomes are successes.
limitations: BB72 X-only CSS code capacity is a controlled adaptation of the cited circuit-level experiments.
The common plain-BP initial run is separate from Relay's paper-defined first memory-BP leg.
A shared additional C2V update cap does not equalize total operations, runtime, or parallel latency.
Selection and evaluation physical sample namespaces are disjoint; no outcome-dependent stopping is allowed.
configuration.selection_rule: For each rate, damping, and method independently: fewest unconditional failures on selection shots; then least total initial-plus-extra C2V work; then lexicographically first profile ID. Freeze before evaluation.

configuration.common_cost_rule: one sealed initial BP producer per physical sample; separate continuation and actual validation leaves
configuration.zero_candidate_original_check_rule: zero actual original checks when no candidate exists

configuration.common_cost_rule: one sealed shared producer per physical sample; separate decision/continuation and validation leaves
